app.name: Glass clock
app.summary: A screensaver clock in frosted glass digits over a picture from Home Assistant.
app.saver_example: 14:05 in glass digits over your picture, Fri 9 Oct above them
app.layout_hint: Automatic stacks the hours over the minutes on a square or tall screen and puts the four digits in a row on a wide one.
app.dim_hint: How much darker the picture gets, so the glass digits stay easy to read.
app.seconds_hint: The two dots between the hours and the minutes blink every second (digits in a row only).
app.detail_hint: Only for Strokes. Full closes free ends with a bright border but needs the most memory. Light skips those caps. Minimal draws the body only. If the screen goes black or flickers, take a lighter setting.
app.mode_hint: Smooth draws every digit as one soft picture with a bright edge all round (little memory, needs PSRAM). Strokes builds the digits from arcs and bars, the first way.
app.offset_hint: Moves the date and time together up (negative) or down (positive).
app.overlay_hint: Shows the picture of the entity with the suffix _overlay over the clock (image.clock becomes image.clock_overlay). A PNG keeps its transparency.
app.overlay_opa_hint: How visible the overlay is as a whole, on top of the PNG's own transparency.
